title: Jamming versus recording and late nights with Bix Beiderbecke
summary: Armstrong says jamming and record dates are played the same way, though jam tapes get commercialized. He recalls Bix at the Sunset in Chicago after hours, and says he enjoys everything he plays.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
